patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: It wakes me up at night and I have to shake it out. Ranked grind, like six hours a night. My little finger's totally fine though — it's the other three that go dead.
clinical.presentationShort: 17yo M — 6 weeks of nocturnal numbness in thumb, index and middle fingers, relieved by shaking. Little finger spared. Tinel's and Phalen's positive.
clinical.presentationLong: 17-year-old male with six weeks of night-time numbness in the thumb, index and middle fingers relieved by shaking the hand, with the little finger entirely spared and positive Tinel's and Phalen's tests.

diagnosis.disposition: Fast Track → night wrist splint, activity and ergonomics advice, GP follow-up; no imaging needed
diagnosis.why: The spared little finger is the whole diagnosis: the median nerve serves the thumb, index, middle and half the ring finger, so ulnar-side sparing points straight at the carpal tunnel. History and exam only — a true ESI 5.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.

aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character. Match the painterly STYLE of the attached reference image - its brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting and palette - but do NOT copy its cropping, camera distance or composition. FRAMING (follow exactly): a full-body WIDE SHOT, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, subject centred. The ENTIRE figure must be inside the frame from the top of the head to the soles of both feet, and the ENTIRE chair must be inside the frame including all four chair legs meeting the floor. Leave clear empty margin on all four sides - roughly 10% of the image width as space above the head and below the feet. This is NOT a close-up, NOT a bust, NOT a head-and-shoulders portrait, NOT a cropped view: the camera is pulled well back so the whole person and the whole chair sit comfortably inside the picture with room around them. Draw the COMPLETE body - head, neck, torso, both arms, both hands, lap, both legs, both feet with shoes. Nothing cropped by the edges, no missing or truncated limbs, no body part fading out or left unfinished. Subject: an asian 17-year-old boy in a League of Legends t-shirt with a gaming headset around his neck, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting forward shaking out his right hand, a game controller resting loosely in his left hand. Expression: mildly annoyed and slightly sheepish. Clearly visible: one hand being shaken out as though asleep; a gaming headset resting around the neck; a game controller held loosely in the other hand. Overall: entirely well, numb hand. The only lettering anywhere in the picture is the words 'LEAGUE OF LEGENDS' printed cleanly across the front of the t-shirt. No other text, no watermarks, no border.
